candidates: When writing a regression test for a bug that caused a spurious warning, assert that no warning is emitted during the operation in addition to asserting the expected return value. For example, spy on the warning emitter (e.g., `jest.spyOn(logger, 'warn')` or `jest.spyOn(console, 'warn')`) before calling `loadConfig(...).parse()` (or equivalent), then `expect(spy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()` after. A test that only checks the parsed output can pass even if the spurious warning regression recurs.
